entries.44.1: सुहृद्वर्गम् the company of friends, विसृज्य तु having dismissed, बुद्ध्या in his mind, निश्चित्य having resolved, राघवः Raghava, समीपे near by, आसीनम् seated, द्वाःस्थम् to the doorkeeper, इदम् this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.44.2: शुभलक्षणम् of auspicious marks, सौमित्रिम् Saumitri, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, महाभागम् the greatly blessed, भरतं च and Bharata, अपराजितम् the unconquered, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, शीघ्रम् quickly, आनय bring
entries.44.3: रामस्य of Rama, वचनम् the word, श्रुत्वा having heard, द्वाःस्थः the doorkeeper, मूर्ध्नि upon his head, कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms, लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, गृहम् to the house, गत्वा having gone, अनिवारितः unhindered, प्रविवेश entered
entries.44.4: कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms, सुमहात्मानम् the exceedingly great-souled one, वर्धयित्वा having hailed, उवाच said, राजा the king, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छति desires, तत्र thither, गम्यताम् let there be a going, मा चिरम् delay not
entries.44.5: सौमित्रिः Saumitri, राघवशासनम् the command of Raghava, श्रुत्वा having heard, बाढम् इति एव so be it indeed, रथम् his chariot, आरुह्य having mounted, राघवस्य of Raghava, निवेशनम् to the dwelling, प्राद्रवत् sped
entries.44.6: प्रयान्तम् setting forth, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा having seen, द्वाःस्थः the doorkeeper, अन्तिकात् from close at hand, तत्र there, भरतम् Bharata, वर्धयित्वा having hailed, कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms, भरतम् to Bharata, उवाच said
entries.44.7: विनयावनतः bowed in humility, भूत्वा having become, राजा the king, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छति desires, भरतः तु and Bharata, द्वाःस्थात् from the doorkeeper, रामसमीरितम् uttered by Rama, वचः the word, श्रुत्वा having heard
entries.44.8: बली the strong one, आसनात् from his seat, तूर्णम् swiftly, उत्पपात sprang up, पद्भ्याम् एव on foot itself, ययौ went, प्रयान्तम् going forth, भरतम् Bharata, दृष्ट्वा having seen, त्वरमाणः hastening, कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms
entries.44.9: शत्रुघ्नभवनम् to the house of Shatrughna, गत्वा having gone, ततः then, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच ह spoke, रघुश्रेष्ठ O best of the Raghus, एहि come, आगच्छ come along, राजा the king, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छति desires
entries.44.10: पूर्वम् already, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, महायशाः of great renown, भरतश्च and Bharata, गतः हि have indeed gone, तस्य his, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा तु having heard, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, परमासनात् from his high seat
entries.44.11: शिरसा with his head, धरणीम् the ground, प्राप्य having touched, यत्र where, राघवः Raghava, प्रययौ went, द्वाःस्थः तु and the doorkeeper, आगम्य having come, कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms, तदा then, रामाय to Rama, समुपस्थितान् arrived, स्वान् his own, भ्रातॄन् brothers, सर्वान् एव all of them, निवेदयामास announced
entries.44.12: कुमारान् the princes, आगतान् had come, श्रुत्वा having heard, चिन्ताव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः his senses troubled with anxiety, अवाङ्मुखः his face bent down, दीनमनाः dejected in mind, द्वाःस्थम् to the doorkeeper, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.44.13: त्वम् you, त्वरान्वितः with all haste, कुमारान् the princes, मत्समीपम् into my presence, प्रवेशय usher in, एतेषु in them, मह्यम् for me, जीवितम् is life, एते these, मम my, प्रियाः dear, प्राणाः life-breaths
entries.44.14: नरेन्द्रेण by the lord of men, आज्ञप्ताः तु being summoned, शक्रतेजसः splendid as Shakra, कुमाराः the princes, प्रह्वाः bowing, प्राञ्जलयः with joined palms, भूत्वा having become, ते they, समाहिताः composed, विविशुः entered
entries.44.15: ते तु and they, सग्रहम् seized by a planet, शशिनं यथा as the moon, प्रभया of its lustre, परिवर्जितम् deprived, सन्ध्यागतम् come to the evening, आदित्यम् इव like the sun, तस्य his, मुखम् face, दृष्ट्वा having seen
entries.44.16: ते they, धीमतः of the wise, रामस्य Rama, बाष्पपूर्णे filled with tears, नयने च and the eyes, दृष्ट्वा having seen, हतशोभम् its beauty gone, पद्मं यथा like a lotus, तस्य his, मुखम् face, वीक्ष्य च and having beheld
entries.44.17: ततः then, त्वरिताः in haste, मूर्धभिः with their heads, रामस्य of Rama, पादौ the feet, अभिवाद्य having saluted, सर्वे all, समाहिताः composed, तस्थुः stood, रामः तु and Rama, अश्रूणि tears, अवर्तयत् shed
entries.44.18: महाबलः the mighty one, तान् them, बाहुभ्याम् with both arms, परिष्वज्य having embraced, उत्थाप्य च and having raised them up, आसनेषु upon the seats, आसत be seated, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, ततः then, वाक्यम् these words, जगाद ह spoke
entries.44.19: नरेश्वराः O lords of men, भवन्तः your honours, मम my, सर्वस्वम् are my all, भवन्तः your honours, मम my, जीवितम् are my life, भवद्भिः by your honours, कृतम् won, राज्यम् the kingdom, पालयामि I do but govern
entries.44.20: नरेश्वराः O lords of men, भवन्तः your honours, कृतशास्त्रार्थाः versed in the sense of the scriptures, बुद्ध्या in understanding, परिनिष्ठिताः च and fully accomplished, अयम् this, मदर्थः matter of mine, सम्भूय together, अन्वेष्टव्यः must be considered
entries.44.21: काकुत्स्थे when Kakutstha, तथा thus, वदति spoke, अवधानपरायणाः intent upon listening, सर्वे all, उद्विग्नमनसः troubled in mind, राजा the king, किं नु what indeed, अभिधास्यति will he say
entries.45.1: समुपविष्टानाम् seated together, दीनचेतसाम् dejected in mind, तेषाम् among those, सर्वेषाम् all, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, परिशुष्यता with a parched, मुखेन mouth, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke
entries.45.2: सर्वे all of you, शृणुत hear, वः to you, भद्रम् good fortune, मनः your mind, अन्यथा otherwise, मा कुरुध्वम् turn not, पौराणाम् among the citizens, मम my, सीतायाम् concerning Sita, यादृशी of what sort, कथा the talk, वर्तते goes about
entries.45.3: सुमहान् exceedingly great, पौरापवादः the slander of the citizens, तथा likewise, जनपदस्य च and of the country parts, मयि regarding me, बीभत्सा abhorrence, वर्तते prevails, सा that, मे my, मर्माणि vital parts, कृन्तति cuts through
entries.45.4: अहम् I, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् Ikshvakus, कुले in the line, जातः किल was born indeed, सीता अपि Sita too, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled, जनकानाम् Janakas, सत्कुले in the noble line, जाता was born
entries.45.5: सौम्य O gentle one, त्वम् you, जानासि know, यथा how, विजने in the lonely, दण्डके Dandaka, वने forest, रावणेन by Ravana, सीता Sita, हृता was carried off, सः च and he, मया by me, विध्वंसितः was destroyed
entries.45.6: तत्र thereupon, जनकस्य of Janaka, सुतां प्रति concerning the daughter, मे my, बुद्धिः thought, उत्पन्ना arose, अत्र there, उषिताम् who had dwelt, इमाम् this, सीताम् Sita, पुरीम् to the city, कथम् how, आनयेयम् should I bring
entries.45.7: ततः then, प्रत्ययार्थम् for the sake of proof, तदा then, सीता Sita, ज्वलनम् the fire, विवेश entered, सौमित्रे O Saumitri, तव your, प्रत्यक्षम् before your very eyes, देवानाम् of the gods, हव्यवाहनः the bearer of oblations, आकाशगोचरः ranging the sky, वायुश्च and the wind, मैथिलीम् Maithili, अपापाम् sinless, आह declared
entries.45.8: पुरा then, सुराणाम् of the gods, सन्निधौ in the presence, सर्वेषाम् of all, ऋषीणां चैव and of the sages, चन्द्रादित्यौ च the moon and the sun too, जनकात्मजाम् the daughter of Janaka, अपापाम् sinless, शंसेते declared
entries.45.9: एवम् thus, शुद्धसमाचारा of pure conduct, देवगन्धर्वसन्निधौ in the presence of gods and gandharvas, लङ्काद्वीपे in the isle of Lanka, महेन्द्रेण by great Indra, मम my, हस्ते in the hand, निवेशिता was placed
entries.45.10: मे my, अन्तरात्मा च and inmost self, सीताम् Sita, शुद्धाम् pure, यशस्विनीम् illustrious, वेत्ति knows, ततः then, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, गृहीत्वा having taken, अहम् I, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, आगतः came
entries.45.11: अयम् तु but this, महान् great, वादः rumour, शोकश्च and grief, मे my, हृदि in the heart, वर्तते abides, सुमहान् exceedingly great, पौरापवादः the slander of the citizens, तथा likewise, जनपदस्य च and of the country parts
entries.45.12: कस्यचित् of any, भूतस्य being, यस्य whose, अकीर्तिः ill fame, लोके in the world, गीयेत is sung, यावत् so long as, शब्दः the report, प्रकीर्त्यते is proclaimed, अधमान् the lowest, लोकान् worlds, पतति एव he verily falls to
entries.45.13: अकीर्तिः ill fame, देवैः by the gods, निन्द्यते is condemned, कीर्तिः good fame, लोकेषु in the worlds, पूज्यते is honoured, सर्वेषाम् of all, सुमहात्मनाम् the exceedingly great-souled, समारम्भः the undertaking, कीर्त्यर्थं तु is for the sake of fame
entries.45.14: पुरुषर्षभाः O bulls among men, अपवादभयात् from fear of slander, भीतः afraid, अहम् I, जीवितम् my life, युष्मान् वा or you, अपि even, जह्याम् would abandon, जनकात्मजाम् the daughter of Janaka, किं पुनः how much more
entries.45.15: तस्मात् therefore, भवन्तः your honours, शोकसागरे in an ocean of grief, पतितम् fallen, पश्यन्तु behold me, अतः than this, अधिकम् greater, किञ्चित् any, दुःखम् sorrow, भूतम् that has ever been, अहम् I, न हि पश्यामि see not at all
entries.45.16: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते at dawn, त्वम् you, सुमन्त्राधिष्ठितम् driven by Sumantra, रथम् the chariot, आरुह्य having mounted, सीताम् Sita, आरोप्य having set upon it, विषयान्ते at the border of the realm, समुत्सृज leave her
entries.45.17: गङ्गायाः तु of the Ganga, परे on the further, पारे bank, महात्मनः of the great-souled, वाल्मीकेः तु Valmiki, दिव्यसङ्काशः resembling a heavenly place, आश्रमः the hermitage, तमसातीरम् the bank of the Tamasa, आश्रितः resting upon
entries.45.18: रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, तत्र there, विजने in a lonely, देशे spot, एनाम् her, विसृज्य having left, शीघ्रम् swiftly, आगच्छ return, ते to you, भद्रम् good fortune, मम my, वचनम् word, कुरुष्व carry out
entries.45.19: अस्मिन् in this matter, सीतां प्रति concerning Sita, कथञ्चन in any wise, न प्रतिवक्तव्यः nothing is to be urged against it, तस्मात् therefore, सौमित्रे O Saumitri, त्वम् you, गच्छ go, अत्र herein, विचारणा deliberation, न कार्या is not to be made
entries.45.20: त्वया by you, एतत् this, प्रतिवारिते if it be opposed, मह्यम् for me, परा the utmost, अप्रीतिः हि is displeasure indeed, मया by me, यूयम् you, भुजाभ्याम् by my arms, जीवितेन च and by my life, शापिताः हि are indeed adjured
entries.45.21: ये those who, कथञ्चन in any wise, अनुनेतुम् to persuade me, वाक्यान्तरे in reply, माम् to me, ब्रूयुः may speak, ते they, मदभीष्टविघातनात् by thwarting what I desire, नित्यम् for ever, अहिताः नाम are indeed no friends
entries.45.22: भवन्तः your honours, मच्छासने in my command, स्थिताः यदि if you stand, माम् me, मानयन्तु let them honour, अद्य today, सीता Sita, इतः from here, नीयताम् let her be taken, मम my, वचनम् word, कुरुष्व carry out
entries.45.23: अहम् I, अनया by her, पूर्वम् formerly, उक्तः was told, अहम् I, गङ्गातीरे on the bank of the Ganga, आश्रमान् the hermitages, पश्येयम् may I see, इति thus, तस्याश्च and her, अयम् this, कामः desire, संवर्त्यताम् let it be brought about
entries.45.24: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा तु having spoken, बाष्पेण with tears, पिहिताननः his face covered, धर्मात्मा the righteous, सः that, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, भ्रातृभिः by his brothers, परिवारितः surrounded, प्रविवेश went within
entries.45.25: शोकसंलग्नहृदयः his heart fastened upon grief, द्विपः यथा like an elephant, निशश्वास sighed deeply
entries.46.1: ततः then, रजन्याम् when the night, व्युष्टायाम् had brightened into dawn, दीनचेतनः dejected in mind, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, परिशुष्यता with a parched, मुखेन mouth, सुमन्त्रम् to Sumantra, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.46.2: सारथे O charioteer, रथोत्तमे to the best of chariots, तुरगान् the horses, शीघ्रम् quickly, योजयस्व yoke, राजभवनात् from the royal house, सीतायाः for Sita, स्वास्तीर्णम् well spread, आसनम् a seat, कुरु make ready
entries.46.3: राजवचनात् at the king's word, पुण्यकर्मणाम् of those of holy deeds, महर्षीणाम् of the great sages, आश्रमम् to the hermitage, सीता Sita, मया by me, नेया हि must indeed be taken, रथः the chariot, शीघ्रम् swiftly, आनीयताम् let it be brought
entries.46.4: सुमन्त्रः तु and Sumantra, तथा इति so be it, उक्त्वा having said, परमवाजिभिः with excellent horses, युक्तम् yoked, सुरुचिरप्रख्यम् of most beautiful appearance, सुखशय्यया with a comfortable couch, स्वास्तीर्णम् well spread, रथम् the chariot
entries.46.5: आनीय having brought it, मित्राणाम् of his friends, मानवर्धनम् increaser of the honour, सौमित्रिम् to Saumitri, उवाच said, प्रभो O lord, अयम् this, रथः chariot, समनुप्राप्तः has been brought, यत् whatever, कार्यम् is to be done, क्रियताम् let it be done
entries.46.6: सुमन्त्रेण by Sumantra, एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, नरर्षभः the bull among men, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, राजवेश्मनि in the royal palace, प्रविश्य having entered, सीताम् Sita, आसाद्य having approached, व्याजहार spoke
entries.46.7: त्वया by you, एषः this, प्रभुः mighty, नृपतिः king, वरम् वै a boon indeed, किल as they say, याचितः was asked, नृपेण by the king, प्रतिज्ञातम् च and it was promised, आश्रमं प्रति toward the hermitage, आज्ञप्तः च and I have been commanded
entries.46.8: देवि O lady, वैदेहि O princess of Videha, नः our, पार्थिवस्य of the king, शासनात् by the command, मया by me, गङ्गातीरे on the bank of the Ganga, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, शुभान् to the auspicious, आश्रमान् hermitages, शीघ्रम् swiftly, गत्वा तु having gone, मुनिभिः by the sages, जुष्टे frequented, अरण्ये in the forest, अपनेया one to be conveyed, भविष्यसि you shall be
entries.46.9: महात्मना by the great-souled, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, एवम् thus, उक्ता तु addressed, वैदेही Vaidehi, अतुलम् unmatched, प्रहर्षम् delight, लेभे obtained, गमनं चापि and the journey too, अरोचयत् she welcomed
entries.46.10: महार्हाणि of great worth, वासांसि garments, विविधानि various, रत्नानि च and jewels, गृहीत्वा having taken, वैदेही Vaidehi, तानि those, गमनाय for the journey, उपचक्रमे set about
entries.46.11: इमानि these, आभरणानि ornaments, महार्हाणि of great worth, वस्त्राणि च and garments, विविधानि various, धनानि च and riches, मुनिपत्नीनाम् to the wives of the sages, अहम् I, दास्यामि shall give
entries.46.12: सौमित्रिः तु and Saumitri, तथा इति so be it, उक्त्वा having said, मैथिलीम् Maithili, रथम् in the chariot, आरोप्य having set, रामस्य of Rama, आज्ञाम् the command, अनुस्मरन् calling to mind, शीघ्रतुरगैः with swift horses, प्रययौ set forth
entries.46.13: तदा then, सीता Sita, लक्ष्मिवर्धनम् increaser of prosperity, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीच्च and said, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, बहूनि एव full many, अशुभानि ill omens, पश्यामि I see
entries.46.14: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, अद्य today, मे my, नयनम् eye, स्फुरति throbs, गात्रोत्कम्पश्च and a trembling of the limbs, जायते arises, हृदयं चैव and my heart too, अस्वस्थम् इव as though unwell, लक्षये I perceive
entries.46.15: पृथुलोचन O large-eyed one, परमम् the utmost, औत्सुक्यम् चापि and disquiet, परा extreme, अधृतिश्च and unsteadiness, मम are mine, पृथिवीम् the earth, शून्याम् एव as if empty, पश्यामि I behold
entries.46.16: भ्रातृवत्सल O you who cherish your brother, वीर O hero, तस्य his, ते your, भ्रातुः brother, स्वस्ति welfare, अपि भवेत् may it be, सर्वासाम् of all, मे my, श्वश्रूणां चैव and mothers-in-law, अविशेषतः without distinction
entries.46.17: पुरे in the city, जनपदे चैव and in the country parts, प्राणिनाम् अपि of living creatures too, कुशलम् welfare, इति thus, अञ्जलिकृता with joined palms, सीता Sita, देवताः the deities, अभ्ययाचत besought
entries.46.18: ततः then, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अर्थम् her meaning, श्रुत्वा having heard, मैथिलीम् Maithili, शिरसा with his head, वन्द्य having saluted, विशुष्यता with a parched, हृदयेन heart, हृष्टः as though glad, शिवम् इति all is well, अब्रवीत् said
entries.46.19: ततः then, गोमतीतीरे on the bank of the Gomati, आश्रमे in a hermitage, वासम् lodging, उपागम्य having taken, प्रभाते at dawn, पुनः again, उत्थाय having risen, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, सूतम् to the charioteer, अब्रवीत् said
entries.46.20: शीघ्रम् quickly, रथम् the chariot, योजयस्व yoke, अद्य today, भागीरथीजलम् the water of the Bhagirathi, शिरसा upon my head, धारयिष्यामि I shall bear, पर्वते upon the mountain, त्र्यम्बकः यथा as the three-eyed one does
entries.46.21: सः he, अथ then, मनोजवान् swift as thought, चतुरः four, अश्वान् horses, रज्वा with the reins, रथे to the chariot, युङ्क्त्वा having yoked, सूतः the charioteer, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, आरोहस्व इति pray mount, अब्रवीत् said
entries.46.22: सा she, सूतस्य of the charioteer, वचनात् at the word, सीता Sita, सौमित्रिणा सार्धम् together with Saumitri, धीमता the wise, सुमन्त्रेण च and with Sumantra, रथोत्तमम् the best of chariots, आरुरोह mounted
entries.46.23: अथ then, अर्धदिवसम् half a day, गत्वा having travelled, भागीरथ्याः of the Bhagirathi, जलाशयम् the sheet of water, विशालाक्षी the large-eyed one, पापविनाशिनीम् destroyer of sin, गङ्गाम् the Ganga, आससाद reached
entries.46.24: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, निरीक्ष्य having gazed upon it, दीनः downcast, महास्वनः in a loud voice, प्ररुरोद wept aloud
entries.46.25: सीता तु and Sita, परमायत्ता greatly troubled, आतुरम् distressed, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा having seen, धर्मज्ञा she who knew dharma, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke, इदम् this, त्वया by you, किम् why, रुद्यते is it wept
entries.46.26: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, मम my, चिराभिलषितम् long desired, जाह्नवीतीरम् the bank of the Jahnavi, आसाद्य having reached, हर्षकाले at a time of joy, किमर्थम् wherefore, माम् me, विषादयसि do you cast into sorrow
entries.46.27: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, त्वम् you, नित्यम् always, रामपार्श्वेषु at the side of Rama, वर्तसे abide, कच्चित् is it that, तेन from him, विनाकृतः separated, द्विरात्रम् for two nights, शोकम् to grief, आगतः have come
entries.46.28: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, मम अपि to me also, रामः Rama, जीवितात् अपि even than life, दयितः is dearer, अहम् I, एवम् thus, न च शोचामि yet do not grieve, त्वम् you, एवम् in this way, बालिशः childish, मा भव do not be
entries.46.29: माम् me, गङ्गाम् across the Ganga, तारयस्व च and carry over, तापसान् the ascetics, दर्शयस्व च and let me see, ततः then, मुनिभ्यः to the sages, वासांसि garments, आभरणानि च and ornaments, दास्यामि I shall give
entries.46.30: ततः then, महर्षीणाम् to the great sages, यथार्हम् as is fitting, अभिवादनम् salutation, कृत्वा having made, तत्र there, एकाम् one, निशाम् night, उष्य having stayed, पुनः again, ताम् that, पुरीम् city, यास्यामः we shall go to
entries.46.31: मम अपि mine too, मनः the mind, पद्मपत्राक्षम् lotus-petal-eyed, सिंहोरस्कम् lion-chested, कृशोदरम् slender-waisted, रमयताम् among those who give delight, वरम् the best, रामम् Rama, द्रष्टुम् to see, त्वरते हि does indeed hasten
entries.46.32: परवीरहा slayer of enemy heroes, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तस्याः her, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, शुभे his fair, नयने eyes, प्रमृज्य having wiped, नाविकान् the boatmen, आह्वयामास summoned
entries.46.33: इयम् this, नौः boat, सज्जा च is made ready, इति thus, दाशाः the ferrymen, प्राञ्जलयः with joined palms, अब्रुवन् said
entries.46.34: गङ्गाम् the Ganga, तितीर्षुः desiring to cross, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, शुभाम् the fair, नावम् boat, उपारुहत् boarded, समाहितः composed, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, ताम् that, गङ्गाम् Ganga, सन्तारयामास had her carried across
entries.47.1: अथ then, राघवानुजः the younger brother of Raghava, पूर्वम् first, मैथिलीम् Maithili, आरोप्य having helped aboard, समायुक्ताम् fully fitted out, सुविस्तीर्णाम् very broad, नैषादीम् of the Nishadas, नावम् the boat, आरुरोह mounted
entries.47.2: शोकसन्तप्तः burning with grief, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सरथम् with his chariot, सुमन्त्रं चैव and Sumantra, स्थीयताम् इति pray remain here, नाविकम् to the boatman, प्रयाहि इति च and push off, उवाच said
entries.47.3: ततः then, सः that, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भागीरथ्याः of the Bhagirathi, तीरम् the bank, उपागम्य having reached, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, बाष्पसम्प्लुतः flooded with tears, मैथिलीम् to Maithili, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke
entries.47.4: वैदेहि O princess of Videha, यस्मात् since, धीमता by the wise, आर्येण by my noble brother, अस्मिन् in this, निमित्ते cause, लोकस्य of the world, वचनीकृतः I have been made a thing of talk, मे my, हृदि in the heart, महत् a great, शल्यम् dart, हृद्गतम् has lodged
entries.47.5: अद्य today, मे for me, मरणम् death, यत् or what, परम् worse, मृत्युः वा or dying, भवेत् might be, श्रेयः हि is indeed better, अस्मिन् in this, ईदृशे such, लोकनिन्दिते condemned by the world, कार्ये task, न च नियोज्यः I should not have been set
entries.47.6: शोभने O fair one, प्रसीद च and be gracious, मे my, पापम् sin, कर्तुम् to make it, न अर्हसि you should not, इति thus, अञ्जलिकृतः with joined palms, सः that, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भूमौ upon the ground, निपपात fell down
entries.47.7: रुदन्तम् weeping, प्राञ्जलिम् with joined palms, आत्मनः his own, मृत्युम् death, काङ्क्षन्तम् longing for, दृष्ट्वा having seen, भृशसंविग्ना greatly agitated, मैथिली Maithili, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.47.8: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, इदम् this, किम् what is it, न अवगच्छामि I do not understand, तत्त्वेन in truth, ब्रूहि tell me, त्वाम् you, स्वस्थम् at ease, न च पश्यामि I do not see, महीपतेः of the king, क्षेमम् अपि nor his welfare either
entries.47.9: नरेन्द्रेण by the lord of men, शापितः असि you have been adjured, यत् that, त्वम् you, सन्तापम् to distress, आगतः have come, तत् that, मह्यम् to me, सन्निधौ here present, ब्रूयाः you should tell, अहम् I, ते you, आज्ञापयामि so command
entries.47.10: वैदेह्या by Vaidehi, चोद्यमानः तु being urged, दीनचेतनः dejected in mind, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अवाङ्मुखः his face bent down, बाष्पकलम् choked with tears, एतत् this, वाक्यम् word, उवाच ह spoke
entries.47.11: जनकात्मजे O daughter of Janaka, त्वत्कृते on your account, पुरे in the city, जनपदे चैव and in the country parts, परिषदः of the assembly, मध्ये in the midst, सुदारुणम् most terrible, अपवादम् the slander, श्रुत्वा हि having indeed heard, रामः Rama, सन्तप्तहृदयः his heart burning, मा me, निवेद्य having instructed, गृहम् to his chamber, गतः went
entries.47.12: देवि O lady, यानि which, राज्ञा by the king, अमर्षात् out of indignation, हृदि in his heart, न्यस्तानि were laid, पृष्ठतः behind him, कृतः were put, तानि those, वचनीयानि things to be uttered, मया by me, तव your, अग्रतः before you, न वचनीयानि are not fit to be uttered
entries.47.13: सा त्वम् you being such, निर्दोषा faultless, पौरापवादभीतेन by him who feared the slander of the citizens, नृपतिना by the king, मम my, सन्निधौ in the presence, त्यक्ता have been abandoned, देवि O lady, ते by you, अन्यथा otherwise, न ग्राह्यम् it should not be taken
entries.47.14: राज्ञः of the king, शासनम् the command, आज्ञाय having received, मया by me, आश्रमान्तेषु at the edge of the hermitages, त्वम् you, त्यक्तव्या to be left, भविष्यसि shall be, तव your, इदम् this, दौर्हृदम् किल is indeed the longing of your condition
entries.47.15: शुभे O fair one, तत् that, एतत् this, जाह्नवीतीरे on the bank of the Jahnavi, ब्रह्मर्षीणाम् of the brahmin sages, तपोवनम् is the penance-grove, पुण्यं च holy, रमणीयं च and delightful, विषादम् despair, मा कृथाः give not way to
entries.47.16: मे my, पितुः father, राज्ञः of king, दशरथस्य Dasharatha, इष्टः dear, मुनिपुङ्गवः bull among sages, परमकः foremost, सखा friend, विप्रः the brahmin, सुमहायशाः of exceedingly great renown, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki
entries.47.17: जनकात्मजे O daughter of Janaka, अस्य his, महात्मनः the great-souled one, पादच्छायाम् the shelter of his feet, उपागम्य having come to, उपवासपरैकाग्रा intent and single-minded in fasting, त्वम् you, सुखम् at ease, वस dwell
entries.47.18: देवि O lady, पतिव्रतात्वम् devotion to your lord, आस्थाय holding fast to, सदा ever, रामम् Rama, हृदि in your heart, कृत्वा having kept, तथा so, कृत्वा having done, ते for you, परमम् the highest, श्रेयः good, भविष्यति shall come
entries.48.1: जनकात्मजा the daughter of Janaka, लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, दारुणम् the terrible, वचः speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, परम् utmost, विषादम् dejection, आगम्य having come to, वैदेही Vaidehi, निपपात ह fell down
entries.48.2: सा she, मुहूर्तम् इव for a moment as it were, असञ्ज्ञा senseless, बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा her eyes clouded with tears, जनकात्मजा the daughter of Janaka, दीनया in a piteous, वाचा voice, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, उवाच said
entries.48.3: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, इयम् this, मामिका my own, तनुः body, धात्रा by the creator, नूनम् surely, दुःखाय for sorrow, सृष्टा was fashioned, यस्याः of which, मे my, अद्य today, तथा so, दुःखमूर्तिः the very embodiment of sorrow, प्रदृश्यते is seen
entries.48.4: पूर्वम् in a former life, किं नु what, पापम् sin, कृतम् was done, कः वा or who, दारैः from his wife, वियोजितः was parted, या अहम् I who, शुद्धसमाचारा of pure conduct, सती a faithful wife, नृपतिना by the king, त्यक्ता am cast off
entries.48.5: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, पुरा formerly, अहम् I, रामपादानुवर्तिनी following at the feet of Rama, आश्रमे in the hermitage, वासम् dwelling, अनुरुध्य अपि though enduring it, दुःखे in hardship, परिवर्तिनी च and moving about
entries.48.6: सौम्य O gentle one, सा I who am such, विजनीकृता left solitary, आश्रमे in the hermitage, कथम् हि how indeed, वत्स्यामि shall I dwell, दुःखपरायणा given over to sorrow, अहम् I, कस्य to whom, दुःखम् my sorrow, आख्यास्यामि च shall I tell
entries.48.7: मुनिषु among the sages, किं नु what indeed, वक्ष्यामि shall I say, कर्म वा or what deed, सत्कृतं च or what good office, किम् was done, कस्मिंश्चित् for some, कारणे cause, महात्मना by the great-souled, राघवेण by Raghava, त्यक्ता I was abandoned
entries.48.8: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, अद्य एव this very day, जाह्नवीजले in the water of the Jahnavi, जीवितम् my life, न खलु त्यजेयम् I would surely not cast away, भर्तुः of my lord, मे my, राजवंशः तु but the royal line, परिहास्यते would be brought to an end
entries.48.9: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, यथाज्ञम् as commanded, कुरु do, दुःखभागिनीम् sharer of sorrow, माम् me, त्यज abandon, राज्ञः of the king, निदेशे in the injunction, स्थीयताम् let there be abiding, मम my, इदम् this, वचः word, शृणु च and hear
entries.48.10: अविशेषेण without distinction, श्वश्रूणाम् of my mothers-in-law, प्राञ्जलिप्रग्रहेण च and with joined palms, शिरसा with my head, चरणौ their feet, आवन्द्य having saluted, पार्थिवम् to the king, कुशलम् my wishes for his welfare, ब्रूहि tell
entries.48.11: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, सर्वासाम् एव to all of them, शिरसा with your head, अभिनतः bowed, ब्रूयाः you should speak, नृपतिः चापि and the king too, धर्मेषु in matters of dharma, सुसमाहितः well settled, वक्तव्यः should be addressed
entries.48.12: राघव O Raghava, सीता Sita, तत्त्वेन in truth, यथा how, शुद्धा is pure, जानासि च you do know, परया with the highest, भक्त्या devotion, युक्ता च and endowed, तव to you, नित्यशः ever, हिता च and well-wishing
entries.48.13: वीर O hero, जने among the people, अयशोभीरुणा fearing dishonour, त्वया by you, अहम् I, त्यक्ता have been abandoned, यत् च and whatever, ते for you, अपवादसमुत्थितम् arising out of the slander, वचनीयम् cause of reproach, स्यात् may be, मया by me, परिहर्तव्यं च and it must be removed, त्वम् हि you indeed, मे my, परमा supreme, गतिः are the refuge
entries.48.14: नृपतिः the king, धर्मेण in dharma, सुसमाहितः well settled, वक्तव्यः should be addressed, इति thus, यथा as, भ्रातृषु toward your brothers, वर्तेथाः you conduct yourself, तथा so, पौरेषु toward the citizens, नित्यदा for ever
entries.48.15: एषः this, ते your, परमः supreme, धर्मः हि duty indeed, तस्मात् from that, अनुत्तमा unsurpassed, कीर्तिः is the fame
entries.48.16: राजन् O king, यत् तु that which, पौरजनः the citizenry, धर्मेण by righteousness, समवाप्नुयात् may attain, नरर्षभ O bull among men, अहम् तु as for me, स्वशरीरम् my own body, न अनुशोचामि I do not grieve over
entries.48.17: रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, यथा as, पौराणाम् of the citizens, अपवादम् the slander, तथैव even so, नार्याः of a woman, पतिः हि the husband indeed, देवता is her deity, पतिः the husband, बन्धुः is her kinsman, पतिः the husband, गुरुः is her teacher
entries.48.18: तस्मात् therefore, प्राणैः अपि even at the cost of life, भर्तुः of the lord, प्रियम् what is dear, विशेषतः above all, कार्यम् must be done, इति thus, मद्वचनात् in my words, रामः to Rama, मम my, सङ्ग्रहः plea, वक्तव्यः should be spoken, ऋतुकालातिवर्तिनीम् one whose season is now past, मा me, अद्य today, निरीक्ष्य having looked upon, त्वम् you, गच्छ go
entries.48.19: सीतायाम् when Sita, एवम् thus, ब्रुवन्त्याम् was speaking, दीनचेतनः dejected in mind, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, शिरसा with his head, धरणीम् the ground, आवन्द्य having saluted, व्याहर्तुम् to utter a word, न शशाक ह was not able
entries.48.20: ताम् her, प्रदक्षिणं च and the rightward circling, कृत्वा having made, महास्वनः in a loud voice, रुदन् एव weeping still, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, ध्यात्वा having pondered, ताम् to her, आह said, शोभने O fair one, माम् to me, किम् what, वक्ष्यसि will you say
entries.48.21: अनघे O blameless one, ते your, रूपम् form, दृष्टपूर्वम् न I have never before beheld, तव your, पादौ feet, दृष्टौ have I seen, अत्र here, वने in the forest, रामेण from Rama, रहिताम् parted, कथम् हि how indeed, पश्यामि can I look upon you
entries.48.22: इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, ताम् her, नमस्कृत्य having saluted, पुनः again, नावम् the boat, उपारुहत् boarded, पुनः again, नावम् the boat, आरुह्य च and having mounted, नाविकम् the boatman, अभ्यचोदयत् urged on
entries.48.23: शोकभारसमन्वितः laden with the burden of grief, सः he, उत्तरम् the northern, तीरम् bank, गत्वा च having reached, दुःखेन with sorrow, सम्मूढः इव as though stupefied, द्रुतम् swiftly, रथम् the chariot, अध्यारुहत् mounted
entries.48.24: मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, परावृत्य turning back, अनाथवत् as one without protector, परतीरस्थाम् standing on the further bank, चेष्टन्तीम् moving to and fro, सीताम् Sita, दृष्ट्वा having seen, अथ then, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्रययौ went on
entries.48.25: दूरस्थम् far off, रथम् the chariot, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, आलोक्य having looked upon, निरीक्षमाणाम् तु as she gazed, उद्विग्नाम् distressed, सीताम् Sita, शोकः grief, समाविशत् entered
entries.48.26: दुःखभारावनता bowed under the burden of sorrow, यशस्विनी the illustrious, यशोधना rich in fame, नाथम् her lord, अपश्यती not seeing, सती the faithful wife, दुःखपरायणा given over to sorrow, सा she, बर्हिणनादिते loud with the cry of peacocks, वने in the forest, महास्वनम् aloud, रुरोद wept
entries.49.1: रुदतीम् weeping, सीतां तु and Sita, दृष्ट्वा having seen, ते those, तत्र there, मुनिदारकाः boys of the hermitage, यत्र where, उग्रधीः of fierce intellect, भगवान् the venerable, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, आस्ते abode, प्राद्रवन् ran
entries.49.2: मुनिपुत्राः the sons of the sages, मुनेः of the sage, पादौ the feet, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महर्षये to the great sage, तस्याः तु of her, रुदितस्वनम् the sound of weeping, सर्वम् all, निवेदयामासुः made known
entries.49.3: भगवन् O venerable one, अदृष्टपूर्वा never seen before, एषा she, कस्य अपि of some, महात्मनः great-souled one, पत्नी is the wife, श्रीः इव like Shri herself, सम्मोहात् out of bewilderment, विकृतानना her face distorted, विरौति cries aloud
entries.49.4: भगवन् O venerable one, त्वम् you, खात् from the sky, च्युताम् fallen, देवताम् इव like a goddess, साधु well, पश्य behold, भगवन् O venerable one, नद्याः तु of the river, तीरे on the bank, का अपि some, वरस्त्री excellent woman, दुःखिता in sorrow
entries.49.5: अस्माभिः by us, प्ररुदिता weeping aloud, दृढम् deeply, शोकपरायणा given over to grief, दृष्टा has been seen, दुःखशोकाभ्याम् of pain and sorrow, अनर्हा undeserving, एकाम् alone, दीनाम् piteous, अनाथवत् हि as one without protector
entries.49.6: एनाम् her, मानुषीम् a mortal woman, न हि विद्मः we do not take to be, अस्याः for her, सत्क्रिया due hospitality, प्रयुज्यताम् let it be shown, आश्रमस्य of the hermitage, अविदूरे च and not far off, इयम् she, त्वाम् you, शरणम् for refuge, गता has come to
entries.49.7: भगवन् O venerable one, साध्वी the virtuous lady, त्रातारम् a protector, इच्छते desires, त्रातुम् to protect her, अर्हसि you should, तेषां तु and of them, वचनम् the words, श्रुत्वा having heard, धर्मवित् the knower of dharma, बुद्ध्या in his mind, निश्चित्य having resolved, तपसा by austerity, लब्धचक्षुष्मान् having gained the inner eye, यत्र where, मैथिली Maithili, प्राद्रवत् hastened
entries.49.8: महामतिम् the great-minded one, एनम् him, प्रयान्तम् going forth, शिष्याः हि the disciples indeed, अभिप्रेत्य having marked, महामतिः the great-minded one, तं तु and that, देशम् place, किञ्चित् for a little way, पद्भ्याम् on foot, अभिप्रेत्य having made toward
entries.49.9: रुचिरम् fair, अर्घ्यम् the guest-offering, आदाय having taken, जाह्नवीतीरम् the bank of the Jahnavi, आगमत् he reached, राघवस्य of Raghava, इष्टाम् the beloved, पत्नीम् wife, सीताम् Sita, अनाथवत् as one without protector, ददर्श he saw
entries.49.10: मुनिपुङ्गवः the bull among sages, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, शोकभारार्ताम् stricken with the burden of grief, ताम् that, सीताम् Sita, तेजसा by his splendour, ह्लादयन् इव as though refreshing her, मधुराम् a sweet, वाणीम् speech, उवाच spoke
entries.49.11: पतिव्रते O devoted wife, त्वम् you, दशरथस्य of Dasharatha, स्नुषा are the daughter-in-law, रामस्य of Rama, प्रिया beloved, महिषी queen, राज्ञः of king, जनकस्य Janaka, सुता the daughter, ते to you, स्वागतम् welcome
entries.49.12: आयान्ती coming hither, चासि and that you were, धर्मसमाधिना by the concentration of dharma, मया by me, विज्ञाता has been known, कारणं चैव and the cause too, सर्वम् entirely, मे by me, हृदयेन in my heart, उपलक्षितम् has been perceived
entries.49.13: महाभागे O greatly blessed lady, तव चैव and yours too, तत्त्वतः in truth, मम to me, विदितम् is known, त्रैलोक्ये in the three worlds, यत् हि whatever indeed, वर्तते goes on, सर्वं च all of it, मह्यम् to me, विदितम् is known
entries.49.14: सीते O Sita, तपोलब्धेन gained by austerity, चक्षुषा with the eye, त्वाम् you, अपापाम् sinless, वेद्मि I know, वैदेहि O princess of Videha, विस्रब्धा at ease, भव be, साम्प्रतम् now, मयि in my keeping, वर्तसे you abide
entries.49.15: मे my, आश्रमस्य of the hermitage, अविदूरे not far away, तापस्यः women ascetics, तपसि in austerity, स्थिताः are established, वत्से O child, ताः they, त्वाम् you, वत्सं यथा as a calf, नित्यशः ever, पालयिष्यन्ति will cherish
entries.49.16: त्वम् you, विस्रब्धा at ease, विगतज्वरा free of anxiety, इदम् this, अर्घ्यम् guest-offering, प्रतीच्छ accept, स्वगृहम् your own home, अभ्येत्य यथा as though you had come to, विषादं चैव and despondency, मा कृथाः give not way to
entries.49.17: सीता Sita, मुनेः of the sage, परमम् most, अद्भुतम् wonderful, भाषितम् speech, श्रुत्वा तु having heard, शिरसा with her head, चरणौ his feet, आवन्द्य having saluted, कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms, तथा इति so be it, आह said
entries.49.18: सीता Sita, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, प्रयान्तम् as he went, तम् that, मुनिम् sage, पृष्ठतः behind, अन्वगात् followed
entries.49.19: मुनिपत्न्यः the wives of the sages, आयान्तम् approaching, तम् that, मुनिम् sage, वैदेह्या with Vaidehi, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मुदा with joy, युक्ताः filled, उपाजग्मुः came near, इदम् this, वचनं च and word, अब्रुवन् spoke
entries.49.20: मुनिश्रेष्ठ O best of sages, ते to you, स्वागतम् welcome, ते your, आगमनं च and your coming, चिरस्य is after long, सर्वाः all of us, त्वाम् you, अभिवादयामः salute, किं च and what, कुर्महे shall we do, उच्यताम् let it be said
entries.49.21: तासाम् their, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said, इयम् this, सीता Sita, धीमतः of the wise, रामस्य Rama, पत्नी the wife, समनुप्राप्ता has come here
entries.49.22: एषा she, दशरथस्य of Dasharatha, स्नुषा the daughter-in-law, जनकस्य of Janaka, सुता the daughter, सती a faithful wife, अपापा sinless, पतिना by her lord, त्यक्ता abandoned, मया by me, सदा ever, परिपाल्या is to be protected
entries.49.23: भवन्त्यः your ladyships, इमाम् her, परमेण with the utmost, स्नेहेन हि affection indeed, पश्यन्तु look upon, मम my, गौरवात् out of regard for, वाक्याच्च and at my word, वः by you, विशेषतः above all, पूज्या honoured, अस्तु let her be
entries.49.24: महायशाः of great renown, महातपाः of great austerity, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, प्रणिधाय having reassured, शिष्यवृतः surrounded by his disciples, पुनः again, स्वम् his own, आश्रमम् hermitage, आयात् went to
